deferrals.upstream_title: Prewarm MCP runtime updates in the background (#35144)
deferrals.reason: The local baseline lacks a published immutable McpRuntime, serialized exact refresh ownership, an authoritative dirty/generation transition, and the latest desired-state plus environment snapshot needed to ensure that stale background work cannot publish or detach a writer.
missing_prerequisites: serialized exact refresh lock and ownership
coalescing worker whose stale generations cannot publish

deferrals.upstream_title: Refresh MCP runtimes when session auth changes (#35146)
deferrals.reason: Credential rotation is a high-priority security semantic, but the local baseline lacks an authoritative authentication generation publisher and watcher, plugin auth-mode binding, a published auth/token snapshot, startup re-projection, and generation-bound coupling between the exposed tool catalog and the executing MCP client.
missing_prerequisites: published immutable auth and token snapshot
generation-bound tool catalog and executing MCP client
required_behavioral_tests: An old-generation runtime is revoked and cannot expose or execute tools after authentication rotation.
A real MCP Authorization header uses the new credential generation after rotation.
A cross-account transition cannot leak the prior account's tool catalog.
A startup authentication race cannot publish a mixed-credential runtime.
Tool exposure and execution always resolve through the same published generation.
